# G8G Media

> Premier creative production studio engineering 3D CGI commercials, technical product demo films, luxury real estate visual showcases, and brand anthems for ambitious technology leaders and global enterprises.

## Organization Overview
- **Parent Enterprise**: G8G Agency
- **Specialized Division**: G8G Media (Creative Video & 3D Motion Production)
- **Official Website**: https://g8g.media
- **Inquiry Email**: hello@g8g.media
- **Turnaround Speed**: 3 to 5 weeks standard; 14-day expedited sprint pipeline available.
- **Track Record**: 120M+ cumulative video views, 80+ commercial productions delivered, 100% on-time milestone delivery.
- **Geographic Coverage**: Worldwide digital production pipeline with clientele across North America, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates (Dubai), European Union, and India.

## Core Capabilities
- **3D CGI Commercials & Architectural Films**: Photorealistic 3D environments, Unreal Engine 5 kinematics, and anamorphic lighting for luxury real estate and physical hardware.
- **Technical Explainer Videos**: Narrative-driven breakdown of complex architectures, distributed ledgers, APIs, and cloud infrastructures.
- **Product Demo Videos**: Interface-accurate, high-frame-rate demonstration films for enterprise SaaS, consumer software, and developer tools.
- **Cinematic Brand Films**: High-concept brand anthems establishing visionary positioning, founder legacy, and market authority.
- **Commercial Advertising & Social Cutdowns**: Performance-tested video packages adapted for 16:9 widescreen, 9:16 vertical (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts), and paid media channels.

## Key Deliverables Provided
Every standard production includes:
- Master 4K ProRes 422 HQ / DCI-P3 Master Files
- Web-optimized H.264 / HLS high-bitrate streaming packages
- 9:16 Vertical Cutdowns for mobile social platforms
- 6-second and 15-second teaser cuts
- Isolated audio stems (Dialogue, Sound Effects, Bespoke Orchestral / Electronic Music)
- Frame-accurate collaborative review via Frame.io with 24–48hr revision turnaround

## Verified Case Studies
- [Real Estate Commercial - Billionaire Rubaab](https://g8g.media/work/nexa-audio-commercial): Luxury real estate architectural cinema and photorealistic 3D CGI for Emirates Billionaire Rubaab. Result: 100% pre-launch inventory commitment within 72 hours.
- [Terra Motors Brand Film](https://g8g.media/work/terra-motors-brand-film): Cinematic brand film with telemetry VFX and live-action cinematography for next-generation electric mobility.
- [GEICO Animated Partnership](https://g8g.media/work/geico-animated-partnership): National animated commercial campaign featuring 3D character animation and cross-network broadcast cutdowns.
- [Crohn's & Colitis Foundation Awareness Film](https://g8g.media/work/crohns-colitis-foundation): Emotionally compelling medical advocacy explainer translating cellular pathophysiology into empathetic visual storytelling.
- [Cisco Meraki Go Product Explainer](https://g8g.media/work/meraki-go-explainer): Enterprise hardware setup and mesh networking made intuitive through slick 3D isometric animation.
- [Nexenta Animated Campaigns](https://g8g.media/work/nexenta-animated-campaigns): Multi-part motion graphics campaign clarifying petabyte-scale software-defined storage architectures.
